item.skyabyss.abyss_whale_hammer.desc: A hammer whose head is one of the stone whale's vertebrae.
item.skyabyss.abyss_whale_staff.desc: A staff whose stone lids cradle a sunken whale's eye.
item.skyabyss.abyss_whale_bow.desc: A bow whose limbs are layered plates of baleen.
item.skyabyss.abyss_whale_fang.desc: A harpoon head that stayed lodged in the stone whale's back.
item.skyabyss.abyss_whale_bell_staff.des: A jawbone staff hung with a whale's ear bone for a bell.
item.skyabyss.abyss_tide_sword.desc: A greatsword whose blade is one long spiral shell.

item.skyabyss.abyss_tide_bow.desc: A bow strung across the rays and web of a great fish's fin.
item.skyabyss.abyss_tide_dagger.desc: A dagger of a great urchin's spine, held by its shell.
item.skyabyss.abyss_storm_sword.desc: A copper-wound lightning rod of a greatsword, forked at the tip.

item.skyabyss.abyss_storm_staff.desc: A staff with a thundercloud shut in a copper cage.

item.skyabyss.abyss_storm_bell_staff.des: A staff hung with copper chimes that ring without wind.
item.skyabyss.abyss_ember_sword.desc: A greatsword of half-cooled lava, its cracks still red.
item.skyabyss.abyss_ember_staff.desc: A staff with a volcanic bomb still floating at its tip.
item.skyabyss.abyss_ember_bow.desc: A bow of obsidian limbs with an ember core showing through.
item.skyabyss.abyss_ember_dagger.desc: A dagger of molten iron that dripped and set in a wavy blade.
item.skyabyss.abyss_ember_bell_staff.des: A bell staff swung with a crucible of molten iron.
item.skyabyss.abyss_lamp_staff.desc: A staff hung with a stone lantern of pale fire, lighting the abyss road.
item.skyabyss.abyss_depth_bow.desc: A bow weighted at both tips with the leads used to sound the depth.
item.skyabyss.abyss_toll_bell_staff.desc: A bronze funeral bell rung by a knotted rope.
item.skyabyss.whale_hammer.desc: A hammer of stone from the stone whale's back.
item.skyabyss.whale_bow.desc: A bow whose limbs are the stone whale's ribs.
item.skyabyss.tide_hammer.desc: A hammer faced with tide shell.
item.skyabyss.tide_bow.desc: A bow grown from the tide shell's coral.
item.skyabyss.storm_hammer.desc: A hammer of the thunder wing's copper.
item.skyabyss.ember_greatsword.desc: A greatsword of the ember titan's basalt.
item.skyabyss.ember_bow.desc: A bow with limbs of the ember titan's iron.
item.skyabyss.ember_dagger.desc: A dagger forged from the ember forge's tongs.
item.skyabyss.whale_staff.desc: A staff whose whale ribs cradle a pale-blue stone.
item.skyabyss.whale_bell_staff.desc: A mossy stone bell from the stone whale's back.
item.skyabyss.tide_staff.desc: A staff lit by a tide shell pearl.
item.skyabyss.tide_bell_staff.desc: Shell bells that ring with the sound of the tide.
item.skyabyss.storm_staff.desc: Thunder wing feathers and copper that call the lightning.
item.skyabyss.storm_bell_staff.desc: Copper bells that peal like thunder.
item.skyabyss.ember_staff.desc: A staff holding an ember of the ember titan.
item.skyabyss.ember_censer.desc: A censer staff that burns embers.

item.skyabyss.shrine_hammer.desc: A hammer the island shrine gives to smiths. Heavy, and it rings well.
item.skyabyss.shrine_bow.desc: A bow the island shrine gives to archers. Plain, but it bends well.
skill.skyabyss.shield_rush.flavor: Once a rock starts rolling, it does not stop.
skill.skyabyss.shield_rush.effect: Close in on a foe you look at within %1$s blocks and strike for %2$s%% of your attack damage. Only on solid ground; never steps off a ledge.
skill.skyabyss.archer_leap.flavor: An archer's distance is always one step farther.
skill.skyabyss.archer_leap.effect: Hop backwards. Only on solid ground with a foe within %1$s blocks.
skill.skyabyss.thunder_bolt.flavor: The stars find the nearest one first.
skill.skyabyss.thunder_bolt.effect: Fires lightning up to %1$s blocks ahead; the first foe takes %2$s spell damage. At rank 3 it jumps to another foe within %4$s blocks for %3$s.

skill.skyabyss.star_reading.effect: While holding a staff, mana regenerates %1$s%% faster.
skill.skyabyss.ember_orb.flavor: Forge fire, carried in the palm.
skill.skyabyss.ember_orb.effect: Throws a slow fireball. On hitting a foe or wall it bursts in %1$s blocks: %2$s spell damage and %3$s s of fire.
skill.skyabyss.frost_tide.flavor: The winter sea freezes you from the ankles up.
skill.skyabyss.frost_tide.effect: A cold tide around you (%1$s blocks): %2$s spell damage and %3$s%% slow for %4$s s (half on large foes).
skill.skyabyss.blink.flavor: The gap between stars is shorter than you think.

skill.skyabyss.star_oath.flavor: Swear by the stars, and pay for the stars.
skill.skyabyss.star_oath.effect: Star skills deal +%1$s%% damage but cost +%2$s%% mana.
skill.skyabyss.forge_stomp.flavor: A smith's feet remember the forge floor.

skill.skyabyss.mist_veil.flavor: Wind readers read the mist too.

skill.skyabyss.curse_mark.flavor: Every tide song has a hidden verse.

skill.skyabyss.lamp_charm.flavor: By the lamp, even the waves are calm.
skill.skyabyss.lamp_charm.effect: Places a lamp at your feet (%1$s blocks, %2$s s). Every %4$s s it tops up ward HP to %3$s for you and allies nearby.

item.skyabyss.shrine_dagger.desc: A dagger the island shrine gives to wind readers. Light and quick.

skilltree.skyabyss.rock.desc: Close-range arts of Strength and Endurance. Draw the foe's aim and stand as the party's wall.
skilltree.skyabyss.wind.desc: Quick close-range offense of Agility. Lunge, leap away, and cut twice from behind.
skilltree.skyabyss.tide.desc: Support and disruption sung with Spirit. Shield allies with absorption and mana, slow foes. No healing.
skilltree.skyabyss.ash.desc: Fiery melee of Strength and Spirit. Set your weapon aglow and scorch the ground with a hammer.
skilltree.skyabyss.bone.desc: Long-range shooting of Agility. Piercing arrows, traps and marks that lift the whole party's damage.
skill.skyabyss.rock_call.flavor: "Here," calls the rock, and the foe stops and turns.
skill.skyabyss.rock_call.effect: Draws the aim of every foe within %1$s blocks onto you for %2$s s. Knockback from drawn foes is x%3$s.
skill.skyabyss.stone_oath.flavor: The stone says nothing and bears the party's weight.
skill.skyabyss.stone_oath.effect: Take %1$s%% of the damage allies within %3$s blocks would take (up to %2$s HP per hit). They lose less; you lose more.
skill.skyabyss.nimble.flavor: The people of the back walk with their steps lent to the wind.
skill.skyabyss.nimble.effect: Ground movement is %1$s%% faster, and falls hurt %2$s blocks less.
skill.skyabyss.foresight.flavor: Knowing what comes, a hair's breadth is enough.
skill.skyabyss.foresight.effect: For %2$s s after a foe's telegraph (circle or line) ends without hitting you, attack speed is %1$s%% higher.
skill.skyabyss.wind_rend.flavor: The wind tears the same place twice. A back is the wind's road.
skill.skyabyss.wind_rend.effect: Two quick cuts. Each hits for %2$s%% of your attack from the front, %1$s%% from behind.
skill.skyabyss.lone_wind.flavor: A wind that left the herd runs fastest.
skill.skyabyss.lone_wind.effect: While no other player is within %3$s blocks: attack +%1$s%%, movement +%2$s%%. Does nothing with company (the solo path).
skill.skyabyss.ward_song.flavor: A sea song guards once, like a bubble.
skill.skyabyss.ward_song.effect: Grants allies within %1$s blocks (you included) %2$s ward HP for %4$s s. Does not stack.
skill.skyabyss.calm_heart.flavor: In a calm chest, strength fills slowly.
skill.skyabyss.calm_heart.effect: Mana regeneration for you and nearby allies is %1$s%% faster (the highest only; no stacking).
skill.skyabyss.ebb_tide.flavor: The ebbing wave takes the sand from under your feet.
skill.skyabyss.ebb_tide.effect: Pulls foes within %1$s blocks ahead to your feet and slows them for %2$s s. Large foes are only slowed.
skill.skyabyss.ripple.flavor: What is touched keeps the wave.
skill.skyabyss.ripple.effect: Foes hit by your skills move %1$s%% slower for %2$s s. Half against large foes.
skill.skyabyss.cycle_song.flavor: The song goes round once and steadies the breath.
skill.skyabyss.cycle_song.effect: Speeds mana regeneration of allies within %1$s blocks by %3$s%% for %2$s s (%4$s%% for you).
skill.skyabyss.chorus_voice.flavor: One voice carries farther the more voices join.
skill.skyabyss.chorus_voice.effect: For each ally within %3$s blocks, your skills are %1$s%% stronger (up to %2$s allies). Nothing alone.
skill.skyabyss.temper.flavor: A blade the color of embers breathes with each swing.
skill.skyabyss.temper.effect: Sets your weapon aglow for %1$s s. Attacks add %2$s%% of attack as fire damage and burn the foe for %3$s s. Aim at yourself or one ally in view (%4$s blocks).
skill.skyabyss.ember_heart.flavor: One who knows fire is slow to burn.
skill.skyabyss.ember_heart.effect: Fire damage you take is %1$s%% lower.
skill.skyabyss.ember_hammer.flavor: Ground that is struck does not sleep for a while.
skill.skyabyss.ember_hammer.effect: Slams ahead (radius %1$s) for %2$s%% of attack. Embers stay %3$s s and burn only foes.
skill.skyabyss.forge_memory.flavor: The forge remembers as much heat as it has been struck.
skill.skyabyss.forge_memory.effect: Each skill use gathers one ember (up to %1$s). Your next melee hit is %2$s%% stronger per ember (all are spent).
skill.skyabyss.ash_scatter.flavor: Under ash, fang and arrow both dull.
skill.skyabyss.ash_scatter.effect: Foes within %1$s blocks are Ash-Covered for %2$s s: attack -%3$s%%, projectile speed -%4$s%%.
skill.skyabyss.smith_eye.flavor: The more a blade is forged, the more it answers the art.
skill.skyabyss.smith_eye.effect: Skill damage rises %1$s%% per enhancement level of your held weapon (%2$s%% at +10).
skill.skyabyss.bone_trap.flavor: Bone is good at waiting to be stepped on.
skill.skyabyss.bone_trap.effect: Sets a bone trap at your feet (up to %1$s). A foe that steps on it is bound for %2$s s and takes %3$s%% of attack. Large foes are not bound and take %4$s%%.
skill.skyabyss.still_string.flavor: The arrow of one who draws and waits is heavy.
skill.skyabyss.still_string.effect: An arrow (or Cloud Pierce) loosed after standing still for %2$s s deals %1$s%% more. Moving resets it.
rune.skyabyss.wide_blade.effect: The cone widens to 180 degrees. Power -10%.
rune.skyabyss.deep_blade.effect: The cone narrows to 30 degrees and hits only the nearest foe for x1.4.
rune.skyabyss.ground_run.effect: No cone; a shockwave 8 blocks long and 1.5 wide runs along the ground.
rune.skyabyss.pincer.effect: Pulls struck foes to your feet (large foes do not move).
rune.skyabyss.heavy_voice.effect: While foes are drawn, damage taken -10%.
rune.skyabyss.rock_return.effect: Each time a drawn foe hits you, your next melee +10%.
rune.skyabyss.pass_through.effect: Land behind the foe (if there is footing).
rune.skyabyss.chain_lunge.effect: On a hit, the cooldown is halved.
rune.skyabyss.pierce_through.effect: Every foe on the path takes x0.6 damage.
rune.skyabyss.return_fire.effect: For 3 s after the leap, projectile damage x1.2.
rune.skyabyss.wind_remnant.effect: A whirl stays 2 s where you stood and slows foes.
rune.skyabyss.back_take.effect: x1.8 from behind, x0.75 from the front.
rune.skyabyss.bleed.effect: The cut foe bleeds for 3 s (damage over time).
rune.skyabyss.companion_wind.effect: Nearby allies move 10% faster for 4 s.
rune.skyabyss.cycling_song.effect: When the absorption breaks, half passes to a nearby ally.
rune.skyabyss.strong_tide.effect: Large foes are pulled about a block too.
rune.skyabyss.whirl.effect: A whirl stays 2 s there, Slowness III.
rune.skyabyss.push_back.effect: Pushes ahead instead of pulling (to a wall).
rune.skyabyss.fire_pillar.effect: Radius narrows to 1.5; the foe at the center takes x1.8.
rune.skyabyss.lightning.effect: A small bolt (30% of the hit) jumps to another foe near the one struck.

gui.skyabyss.skill.loadout_save_tip: Press Save, then a number, to store the current slots, runes and chains in loadout %1$s (%2$s).
gui.skyabyss.skill.main_stat_none: A common tree anyone may take
gui.skyabyss.skill.rune_locked: Runes open once you master a skill.
gui.skyabyss.skill.slot_locked: This slot opens with the second calling (after chapter 3).
gui.skyabyss.skill.respec_early: Until level %3$s, respec anywhere for free.
gui.skyabyss.skill.rank_capped: Skills outside your calling trees stop at rank %s.
message.skyabyss.skill.rune_failed.not_a: That rune cannot be chosen yet.
message.skyabyss.skill.rune_failed.not_q: Runes can be swapped only out of combat (30 s without hurting or being hurt).
message.skyabyss.skill.rune_failed.no_pl: Swap near a forge or campfire (anywhere with the Journal).
message.skyabyss.skill.loadout_failed.em: That set is not saved yet.

Switch near a forge or campfire (anywhere with the Journal).

gui.skyabyss.calling.title: Choose a Calling
gui.skyabyss.calling.lead: The titan sleeps. What will your hands inherit?
gui.skyabyss.calling.lead2: The thunder wing sleeps. Your hands learned more.
gui.skyabyss.calling.deep: You receive this tree's keystone and an innate trait; 3 ranks of this tree cost 1 point less.
gui.skyabyss.calling.deep2: You receive this tree's keystone. One more skill slot.
legend.skyabyss.pike_bone.effect: Pierces everyone on the path; every third time bone erupts underfoot.
legend.skyabyss.fang_bite.effect: Two cuts become three, and the damage from behind becomes bleeding (3 s).
legend.skyabyss.shears_cut.effect: Freezes struck foes for 1 s (0.5 s for large foes).
legend.skyabyss.harpoon_tie.effect: Instead of pulling, ties foes with a harpoon. When a tied foe moves, its neighbors are dragged too.
legend.skyabyss.claw_ring.effect: The start and landing points are joined by a ring of thunder; foes between take x0.8.
legend.skyabyss.halberd_hook.effect: Gathers drawn foes into one spot (the pack clumps).
legend.skyabyss.hammer_forge.effect: Embers last 8 s; foes standing in them deal 10% less.
legend.skyabyss.poker_share.effect: Temper up to two allies at once.
gui.skyabyss.skill.legend_need: Works only while you hold that weapon. Requires %s.

rune.skyabyss.mastery.effect: A 4th rune that opens at mastery %1$s. Skill power +10%%, cooldown -8%% (mastery now %2$s).
gui.skyabyss.skill.loadout_mode_tip: Toggles save mode: the next number you press stores the current slots, runes and chains there. %1$s loadouts.
gui.skyabyss.skill.tryon_locked: While trying on you can only learn skills.

gui.skyabyss.skill.tryon_undo_tip: Take back the last provisional point.
gui.skyabyss.skill.tryon_cancel_tip: Drop the try-on and return to your real build.
gui.skyabyss.skill.page_tip: Switch between the tree page and the page for stances, chains, tags and keystones.
gui.skyabyss.skill.mastery_line: Mastery %1$s (%2$s / next %3$s). Grows by casting, hitting, and hitting right after a dodge.
gui.skyabyss.skill.mastery_locked: Opens at mastery %s. Cast, hit and hit after dodges to grow it.
gui.skyabyss.skill.keystone_hint: 1 point each. Remove out of combat. Needs %s points in that tree
message.skyabyss.skill.keystone_failed.n: Remove it out of combat (30 s)
message.skyabyss.skill.tryon_partial: Only %1$s of %2$s were learned (a condition was not met)
skill.skyabyss.deep_pull.flavor: The deep tugs, a little, at those who look in.
skill.skyabyss.deep_pull.effect: Draw foes around you (radius %1$s) to a point ahead and strike for %2$s%% attack. Slow them by %3$s%% (%4$s s).
skill.skyabyss.deep_mirror.flavor: The more you mix, the deeper the mirror.
skill.skyabyss.deep_mirror.effect: While you count %2$s or more different tags, all skills +%1$s%% power.
skill.skyabyss.deep_echo.flavor: The skill that should have ended is still ringing.
skill.skyabyss.deep_echo.effect: For %2$s s, all skills +%1$s%% power (deals no damage itself). Cooldown %3$s s.
skill.skyabyss.deep_tithe.flavor: Not for the one with plenty: an offering from the deep to the one with few.
skill.skyabyss.deep_tithe.effect: Of your tags other than the most numerous, the %1$s largest (with at least 1) each count +1.
skill.skyabyss.deep_maw.flavor: If the deep has a mouth, it is smiling.
skill.skyabyss.deep_maw.effect: Drag foes within radius %1$s of where you look (up to %3$s blocks) in, then bite for %2$s%% attack 0.4 s later. Cooldown %4$s s.
skill.skyabyss.deep_oath.flavor: The deep swears only to one who holds all five colors.
skill.skyabyss.deep_oath.effect: While you count at least one of each tag (Rock, Wind, Tide, Ash, Bone): all skills +%1$s%% power, mana regeneration +%2$s%%.
skill.skyabyss.echo_strike.flavor: The lingering scent of the last blow of a past life.
skill.skyabyss.echo_strike.effect: Strike one foe ahead (within %2$s blocks) for %1$s%% attack in total: 65%% now, 35%% as an echo 0.5 s later.
skill.skyabyss.old_vigil.flavor: Where the eyes rest of one who has counted the nights.
skill.skyabyss.grave_bell.flavor: When it tolls, the person you once were stops in their tracks.
skill.skyabyss.grave_bell.effect: Strike foes around you (radius %1$s) for %2$s%% attack and slow them by %3$s%% (%4$s s).
skill.skyabyss.memory_edge.flavor: With every rebirth the blade is honed a little.
skill.skyabyss.memory_edge.effect: Per rebirth, skills +%2$s%% power x rank (up to %3$s rebirths; this rank's cap is +%1$s%%).
skill.skyabyss.final_light.flavor: The last moment of a past life, once more.
skill.skyabyss.final_light.effect: Rings of light spread three times; foes around you (radius %1$s) take %2$s%% attack and are pushed out. Cooldown %3$s s.
skill.skyabyss.soul_thread.flavor: However often it is tied, the thread never breaks in the same place.
skilltree.skyabyss.deep.desc: A sixth tree open only to the reborn. Entry at rebirth 1, every tier by rebirth 5. Built around skills meant to be mixed into the other trees.
skilltree.skyabyss.past.desc: Skills of a past life, opened by your rebirth count. Their points are a separate pool (2 per rebirth, up to 12).
mutation.skyabyss.cleave_cliff.effect: Instead of a fan, a column of rock 10 blocks long and 3 wide heaves up. 80%% damage (x1.5 more on large foes), up to 5 foes.
mutation.skyabyss.sweep_tail.effect: One sweep becomes two spreading rings: 60%% in the inner ring, 60%% again in the outer ring 0.4 s later (with a shove).
mutation.skyabyss.rend_blade.effect: A crescent blade flies 12 blocks forward, hitting up to 3 foes, and returns 0.4 s later for 80%% more.
mutation.skyabyss.rain_comet.effect: The six pulses of rain become one great star: after 0.6 s it falls on radius 3.5 for 85%% of the six pulses.
mutation.skyabyss.ebb_whirl.effect: Foes on every side are drawn into one point and slowed. The whirl lingers.
mutation.skyabyss.lunge_surge.effect: Even with no target, dash 8 blocks forward like water, cutting everyone in your path.
mutation.skyabyss.hammer_meteor.effect: A ball of fire falls 6 blocks ahead; 0.5 s later it deals the hammer's damage and leaves an ember bed.
mutation.skyabyss.trap_mine.effect: Instead of a binding trap, bury a fire mine where you look. When stepped on (or after 6 s) it blasts radius 3 and burns.

abyss_art.light.effect: Places a light. Enemies in its glow show their outline. The caster gets night vision.
abyss_art.weight.effect: Eases the rising weight. Only for the caster.
abyss_art.heartbeat.effect: Hears enemy heartbeats through walls and shows them. Heals nearby allies.
message.skyabyss.art.tree_open: The Abyss Art tree is open. Sneak and press the key to raise an art.
message.skyabyss.art.need_tree: Open the Abyss Art tree at the ash pool before raising arts
message.skyabyss.art.light_placed: Light placed. Enemies in it are visible.
message.skyabyss.raid.rejoin: Back to the room where your party is
message.skyabyss.raid.wipe: Everyone is down. Back to the room entrance
raid.skyabyss.WRM.clear: Defeat the captain's guard (%s left); the Bone Captain comes next
raid.skyabyss.WRM.wave: The captain's guard rises from the bone floor
raid.skyabyss.WRM.captain: The Bone Captain steps out at the far end of the hall
raid.skyabyss.TRM.begin: The Tide Beckoner rises from the sand
raid.skyabyss.TRM.beckon: The beckoner calls the tide. Climb onto a rock!
raid.skyabyss.TRM.rocks: The tide is in: stand on a rock, then strike the Tide Beckoner
raid.skyabyss.TRM.defeat: Defeat the Tide Beckoner (watch the red bands)
raid.skyabyss.SRM.begin: Thunder falls on a rod: the Raiju is here
raid.skyabyss.SRM.defeat: Defeat the Raiju: pull a rod's lever to ground it; the Raiju falls when it lands there
raid.skyabyss.ERM.begin: The Ash Smith wakes at the anvil
raid.skyabyss.ERM.defeat: Defeat the Ash Smith: strike its back, cool off on the grey ash puddles
trial.skyabyss.cell.WR1.desc: Carry three bone orbs to the altar. Holding one slows you and stops jumping. Dropped orbs return.
trial.skyabyss.cell.WR2.desc: Strike the four corner bones in ring order. Two players can strike a chord. Wrong notes are free.
trial.skyabyss.cell.WR3.desc: Defend the core at the room's centre through three waves. If its health runs out, the room starts over.
raid.skyabyss.WR1.carry: Carry the three glowing bone orbs to the north altar (slow and no jumping while carrying; follow the light pillar)
raid.skyabyss.WR1.carrying: Bring it to the altar under the light pillar! Foes go for the orb bearer
raid.skyabyss.WR2.listen: Listen to the order the four corner bones ring in
raid.skyabyss.WR2.strike: Strike the corner bones in the order you heard (for a double note, hit both within 8 seconds)
raid.skyabyss.WR3.defend: Guard the whale core in the middle: kill the foes that reach it (three waves)
message.skyabyss.raid.WR3.broken: The whale core shattered. Back to the room entrance
trial.skyabyss.cell.WR4.desc: Fluid rises from the shaft floor. Strike a bone stud to grow a stair to the next landing.
trial.skyabyss.cell.WR5.desc: The floor tiles turn when struck. Join the whale's bones to match the pattern carved on the north wall. The shape changes every run. A balcony gives a view of everything.
trial.skyabyss.cell.WR6.desc: The safe ring on the floor slowly shrinks. Outside it the floor turns red and hurts anyone standing there. Defeat three waves inside the ring.
raid.skyabyss.WR4.climb: Climb to the top: strike the bone knob at a landing's edge to grow the next stairs
raid.skyabyss.WR5.align: Strike the floor slabs to turn them until they form the whale skeleton shown on the north wall
raid.skyabyss.WR6.fight: Stay inside the shrinking ring and defeat three waves
message.skyabyss.raid.WR4.filled: The fluid has filled the shaft. Back to the room entrance
trial.skyabyss.cell.ER1.desc: Carry three embers to the cold forge before they cool. Carriers burn; sneak to hand off to an ally.
trial.skyabyss.cell.ER2.desc: Use four stations in mural order: mold, fire, water, hammer. A wrong order resets them; no damage.
trial.skyabyss.cell.ER3.desc: Defend the forge from three waves. Ash foes douse it. Relit braziers slow them; if it dies, restart.
trial.skyabyss.cell.ER4.desc: Bridges over embers. Planks fall one after another once stepped on; run across. Fallers return to the island; no damage.
trial.skyabyss.cell.ER5.desc: Four north-wall gauges. Right-click raises a needle and lowers its neighbours. Match all four.
trial.skyabyss.cell.ER6.desc: Four apprentices come one at a time, each stronger, each with one more smith move. Defeat all four.
raid.skyabyss.ER1.fetch: Walk onto the vent in the north to take an ember, then carry it to the cold forge in the south (3 embers)
raid.skyabyss.ER1.deliver: Carry the ember to the cold forge before it cools (follow the light; sneak to hand it over)
raid.skyabyss.ER2.charge: Stand on each of the four stations until it glows, then sneak on them in the order the north mural shows
raid.skyabyss.ER2.use: Sneak on ready stations in the mural's order
raid.skyabyss.ER2.wrong: Wrong order. The stations cooled and reset
raid.skyabyss.ER3.defend: Defeat the ash foes before they douse the great forge in the middle (3 waves; stand by a brazier to relight it)
raid.skyabyss.ER3.lost: The forge went out. Back to the room entrance
raid.skyabyss.ER4.cross: Cross the three chain bridges to the stairs at the far end (planks fall behind you; keep walking)
raid.skyabyss.ER5.align: Turn the valves until all four needles sit on the same mark (right-click forward, left-click back)
raid.skyabyss.ER5.done: The needles agree. The forge breathes
raid.skyabyss.ER6.fight: Defeat the apprentices (watch for the red marks)
raid.skyabyss.ER6.enter: Apprentice %s of %s steps up to the forge
trial.skyabyss.cell.SR1.desc: Carry three lightning feathers to the east perches. The carrier is struck on a beat.
trial.skyabyss.cell.SR2.desc: Strike the copper wire tiles to turn them and link the central source to four lamps. No enemies.
trial.skyabyss.cell.SR3.desc: Foes charge over time and glow when full. Defeating a glowing one arcs lightning to nearby foes.
raid.skyabyss.SR1.carry: Pick up a glowing feather in the west and carry it to a perch in the east (3 feathers; follow the light)
raid.skyabyss.SR1.carrying: Lightning incoming! Step out of the red ring, or stand on a grounding plate or by a charm-bearer
raid.skyabyss.SR2.connect: Hit tiles to turn them and link the gold source to all four lamps
raid.skyabyss.SR3.chain: Defeat every foe (killing a glowing foe sends lightning to the ones nearby)
raid.skyabyss.SR3.elite: Defeat the charged elite (pop glowing moths next to it)
message.skyabyss.raid.SR1.grounded: The bolt fled into a grounding plate
message.skyabyss.raid.SR1.struck: Struck! The feather returns to its place
trial.skyabyss.cell.TR1.desc: Dark coral hall, lit only around the pearl carrier. Carry pearls to the altar; sneak to hand off.
trial.skyabyss.cell.TR2.desc: Open shells to hear tones; find the matching pair. A wrong pair costs no health; shells close.
trial.skyabyss.cell.TR3.desc: Defend three coral saplings from three waves. If all three are lost, the room starts over.
raid.skyabyss.TR1.fetch: Take a pearl from its stand and carry it to the altar under the light pillar
raid.skyabyss.TR1.carrying: To the altar under the light pillar! Foes go for the light (crouch to hand it to an ally)
raid.skyabyss.TR2.first: Open shells and find the matching tone
raid.skyabyss.TR2.second: Open another shell with the same tone
raid.skyabyss.TR3.ready: Get ready: guard the three coral saplings
raid.skyabyss.TR3.defend: Kill the foes that come to gnaw the coral saplings (three waves)
message.skyabyss.raid.TR1.dropped: The light went out. The pearl returned to its stand
trial.skyabyss.cell.TR4.desc: Coral walls: gates close as branches grow, open as they draw back. Pink-carpet gates close in order.
trial.skyabyss.cell.TR5.desc: Turn the pearl pedestals to bend the beam from the south lighthouse to the north crystal.
trial.skyabyss.cell.TR6.desc: Six moon murals; dots show the calendar number. Turn moonstones to match each numbered pedestal.
trial.skyabyss.cell.TR7.desc: The real mother casts a shadow and leaves footprints; copies pop when hit. Defeat her to pass.
raid.skyabyss.TR4.cross: Cross the three coral walls through an open door (the light pillar marks one; standing in a door keeps it open)
raid.skyabyss.TR5.guide: Turn the pearl stands to bring the lighthouse beam to the crystal on the north wall (use = clockwise, strike = back)
raid.skyabyss.TR6.arrange: Turn each moon stone to the moon on the mural with the same number of dots (use = next shape, strike = previous)
raid.skyabyss.TR7.find: Find and defeat the real brood mother: she casts a shadow and leaves wet footprints
message.skyabyss.raid.TR7.decoy: A copy. It pops and fades
message.skyabyss.raid.TR3.lost: The saplings are gone. Back to the room entrance

item.skyabyss.regen_draught.desc: Closes wounds little by little for 45 seconds

item.skyabyss.night_eye_draught.desc: See clearly in the dark for 3 minutes
item.skyabyss.antidote.desc: Clears only harmful effects such as poison, weakness and slowness
item.skyabyss.town_bread.desc: Bread baked in a town oven
item.skyabyss.dried_fish.desc: Salted and dried fish. Food for the road
item.skyabyss.honey_jar.desc: Sweet honey. Eating it draws out poison
item.skyabyss.travel_arrow.desc: An arrow for the bow. Pick it up to use it again
item.skyabyss.glow_arrow.desc: Whatever it hits glows for a while
item.skyabyss.iron_lump.desc: Hammered iron. Bought and sold by the material trader
item.skyabyss.copper_lump.desc: A cake of copper. Also used for lightning pillars
item.skyabyss.charcoal_lump.desc: A cracked lump of charcoal. For kilns and forges
item.skyabyss.sky_stone.desc: Stone from beneath the peaks that lightning cannot pass
item.skyabyss.gold_grain.desc: Small grains of gold from the rock
item.skyabyss.glint_shard.desc: Shards of crystal in different colours
item.skyabyss.wheat_sheaf.desc: Wheat tied with rope. Bakes into bread
item.skyabyss.thread_spool.desc: Thread wound on a wooden spool
item.skyabyss.ember_rod.desc: A black rod with embers in its core. Fuel for the forge
item.skyabyss.ember_drop.desc: A drop of fire that never cools
item.skyabyss.blank_chart.desc: A sea chart with nothing drawn on it
item.skyabyss.skiff.desc: A plank skiff. Use it on water to float it and climb in
item.skyabyss.water_skin.desc: Use it at water to fill it
item.skyabyss.indigo_bookmark.desc: A bookmark with a pressed indigo flower
message.skyabyss.heart_wipe.titan: Everyone fell in the heart chamber. You wake on the ground before the titan
message.skyabyss.heart_wipe.shrine: Everyone fell in the heart chamber. You wake before the shrine stone
legend.skyabyss.whale_temper.effect: After tempering, allies within 6 gain 5 s of stone ward.
legend.skyabyss.whale_starfall.effect: A stone falls where the bolt hit a second later, launching foes within 2.5 (spell x0.6).
legend.skyabyss.whale_rib_pierce.effect: Whalebone thrusts up under foes along your aim (attack x0.4).
legend.skyabyss.whale_deep_ward.effect: The ward song tolls deep, binding foes within 5 for 2 s.
legend.skyabyss.tide_stomp.effect: The stomp wells up the tide, healing allies within 5 (attack x0.4).
legend.skyabyss.tide_bubble.effect: A pearl bubble lingers 3 s where it lands, healing allies within 4 each second.
legend.skyabyss.tide_coral_trap.effect: Pulls foes within 4 of the trap to its center and slows them for 3 s.
legend.skyabyss.tide_surf_lamp.effect: Allies within 4 of the lantern heal each second for 5 s.
legend.skyabyss.storm_anvil.effect: Lightning strikes three foes around the blow (attack x0.5).
legend.skyabyss.storm_surge.effect: Lightning rides the tide, striking three foes ahead (spell x0.4).
legend.skyabyss.storm_gale_rain.effect: Blows foes out of the volley area; you move faster for 3 s.
legend.skyabyss.storm_bell_pull.effect: A second after the pull, lightning strikes foes within 4 (spell x0.5).
legend.skyabyss.ember_rush.effect: Embers line the path of the rush; foes touched burn for 3 s (attack x0.3).
legend.skyabyss.ember_ash_veil.effect: The mist turns to hot ash; foes within 4 burn for 4 s.
legend.skyabyss.ember_kiln_blink.effect: Where you stood bursts like a kiln, burning foes within 3 (spell x0.6).
legend.skyabyss.ember_flare.effect: The struck foe and those within 2.5 burn for 4 s (attack x0.3).
legend.skyabyss.ember_censer_song.effect: Censer smoke wraps allies within 6: 8 s of fire ward and a little healing.
item.skyabyss.whale_choir_hammer.desc: A hexagonal anchor-stone wrapped in chain; each blow sings like the whale.
item.skyabyss.whale_star_staff.desc: A crescent jawbone holding three floating stones.
item.skyabyss.whale_rib_longbow.desc: Stone limbs hung with chain links, crusted with barnacles.
item.skyabyss.whale_deep_bell_staff.desc: A whale-headed stone bell hanging from a bone hook.
item.skyabyss.tide_reef_hammer.desc: A hammer shaped like a small lighthouse laid on its side; its lamp glows pink.
item.skyabyss.tide_pearl_staff.desc: Coral branches bearing small pearls at their tips.
item.skyabyss.tide_surf_bell_staff.desc: A conch hangs mouth-down from the hook, a pearl for its clapper.
item.skyabyss.storm_anvil_hammer.desc: A round steel head with feathered wings opening at its sides.
item.skyabyss.storm_cloud_staff.desc: A ring of feathers around an eye-like stone.
item.skyabyss.storm_gale_bow.desc: Copper limbs bent twice like lightning.
item.skyabyss.storm_thunder_bell_staff.d: A copper wind-chime hangs from the hook.
item.skyabyss.ember_cinder_blade.desc: A great blade with a flame-wavy edge and a kiln-mouth guard.
item.skyabyss.ember_ash_knife.desc: A slim knife ground from an obsidian shard.
item.skyabyss.ember_kiln_staff.desc: Embers burn inside an iron cage.
item.skyabyss.ember_flare_bow.desc: Charred branch limbs, orange light leaking from their cracks.
item.skyabyss.ember_censer_bell_staff.de: A pierced censer hangs from an iron hook.

node.skyabyss.archer.still_air.effect: While standing still, damage taken −6%; projectile damage +4%

skill.skyabyss.twin_fang.flavor: If once is not enough, twice.
skill.skyabyss.twin_fang.effect: Stab the foe you look at twice for %1$s%% of attack damage each. From behind, both hits are %2$s×.
skill.skyabyss.spark_burst.flavor: Strike iron and the sparks scatter on their own.
skill.skyabyss.spark_burst.effect: Foes within %1$s blocks take %2$s%% of attack damage and burn for %3$s s.

skill.skyabyss.stardust.effect: Foes within %1$s blocks take %2$s%% of spell damage and are pushed back a little.
